Entries.Original: We'll be continuing training for Phase Five today.
Your main task is to stay alert on standby, so it's important to keep your mood in check.
Ehh, I'm not really good at that... I'd even get bored when waiting for my turn to play during a festival. Any way to work around that?
You could try enjoying the other bands' music.
Keeping well-rested is an important part of the job, so remember to rest when needed.
You'll be taking rests in turns, so keep in mind who's resting and who's on standby as well.
If you don't have an accurate grasp over what everyone is doing, you might find that the backup you were relying on isn't available.
Is there a specific order we should be taking rests?
The order is up to you all to decide. A common method is to rotate out units with the same strategic role.
For example, in 31-A, you could have Kayamori and Aikawa take turns resting. This will let at least one close-combat unit be available in emergencies.
What about Aoi? There isn't another shield-wielder, right?
The exact roles don't have to be so precise. You could just split it between frontliner and reserve units.
Any other questions? If not, we'll begin the training.
Now initializing training module. Remember what we taught you.
